words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa-}}) opens 19:13 by refusing a hard reset after 19:12. It attaches the first new gift noun, {{ar:حَنَانًا}} ({{tr:ḥanānan}}), to the earlier bestowal frame of {{ar:آتَيْنَاهُ}} ({{tr:ātaynāhu}}) (19:12), so the ayah starts inside an already-open divine gift enumeration. At the same time, the particle is the first pulse in a threefold local pattern: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa-}}), then {{ar:وَزَكَاةً}} ({{tr:wa-zakātan}}), then {{ar:وَكَانَ}} ({{tr:wa-kāna}}). The reader therefore hears both cross-boundary governance and staged local movement: tenderness, purity, then character-verdict.

words.prose: {{ar:حَنَانًا}} ({{tr:ḥanānan}}) is the first content word of the ayah and remains grammatically tied to the earlier giving verb in 19:12. Its accusative form can be heard as another bestowed object, and the tamyīz possibility keeps a manner-of-giving pressure alive; either way, tenderness is not a loose description beside Yaḥyā. The following {{ar:مِن لَدُنَّا}} ({{tr:min ladunnā}}) makes the gift provenance explicit, so the compassion is heard as coming from divine near-presence. Lexically, the word is more intimate than a generic mercy label: the root evidence points to warm, yearning tenderness directed toward the vulnerable, and the previous word {{ar:صَبِيًّا}} ({{tr:ṣabiyyā}}) (19:12) makes that child-directed register locally apt. Its breathy opening and repeated nasal sound give the tenderness a soft lexical texture, and its tanwīn begins the shared indefinite cadence later heard in {{ar:زَكَاةً}} ({{tr:zakātan}}) and {{ar:تَقِيًّا}} ({{tr:taqiyyā}}). Its maṣdar-like, indefinite accusative shape packages tenderness as an expansive gift-quality rather than as Yaḥyā's performed act, while rarity and the same-surah echo with the request from {{ar:لَدُنكَ}} ({{tr:ladunka}}) (19:5) make this opening gift lexically load-bearing.

Because the preposition comes after the gift noun, the listener first hears tenderness and then receives its source. That suffix changes the phrase from abstract proximity into divine self-source. words.prose: {{ar:زَكَاةً}} ({{tr:zakātan}}) is coordinated with {{ar:حَنَانًا}} ({{tr:ḥanānan}}) and remains accusative under the prior giving frame, so purity is part of what is bestowed in the profile rather than a detached comment. Yet the repeated source phrase is absent here, leaving the second gift less explicitly source-marked than the first. Lexically, the word should not be flattened into institutional alms in this birth-gift context. The root field carries purity, soundness, increase, and clean growth, so the local payoff is moral-spiritual flourishing: purity as something alive and growing, not static innocence. The noun form also matters. It is not a causative verb of purifying someone else and not a reflexive verb of self-purification; it names a received quality. Its open vowels and tanwīn keep the middle word flowing inside the ayah's indefinite cadence, lighter than the dense source phrase before it and the compact closing predicate after it. Same-surah echoes in 19:31 and 19:55 later move zakāh language into commanded practice, while 19:13 places it as inner prophetic profile. Sitting between tenderness and {{ar:تَقِيًّا}} ({{tr:taqiyyā}}), it mediates affective gift and protective character.

words.prose: {{ar:كَانَ}} ({{tr:kāna}}) introduces the only finite verbal clause in 19:13, but it is not an action verb here. With {{ar:تَقِيًّا}} ({{tr:taqiyyā}}) as its predicate, it functions as a defective copula that assigns a stable quality. Its perfect form presents the moral status as settled within the portrait, not as an ongoing becoming, future possibility, or command to become. The 3ms morphology carries the subject without repeating Yaḥyā's name, so the clause depends on the prior ayah for antecedent recovery while avoiding a new explicit noun. Within Surah 19, the same kāna-plus-taqwā field reappears with different force: 19:18 uses the quality conditionally in Mary's address, while 19:63 opens it to the class who inherit Paradise. The wider formula also appears in community and prophetic-community statements such as 12:57, 12:109, 10:63, and 27:53, while here it is applied to one prophet as a closing certification. Architecturally, {{ar:كَانَ}} ({{tr:kāna}}) shifts the ayah from two bare gift nouns into a verdict-like character seal.

words.prose: {{ar:تَقِيًّا}} ({{tr:taqiyyā}}) is the predicate that completes {{ar:كَانَ}} ({{tr:kāna}}). Its masculine singular accusative agreement ties the quality to Yaḥyā's implicit subject and keeps it inside the copular clause rather than floating as a loose adjective. The word is more concrete than a thin piety gloss: the {{ar:و ق ي}} ({{tr:w-q-y}}) field centers guarding and shielding, so the final attribute presents protective moral vigilance, a character that wards off wrong. Its qualitative adjective form makes that shielding an abiding identity, not a single act of self-guarding and not the plural class label used elsewhere. Indefiniteness and the doubled yāʾ intensify the closing word, while its rarity against the wider taqwā vocabulary concentrates a large ethical field into one person-label. Same-surah recurrence sharpens the force: in 19:18 the quality is invoked conditionally in Mary's appeal, and in 19:63 it opens toward those who inherit Paradise; in 19:13 it is divine certification of Yaḥyā. As the last word, it seals the sequence begun by {{ar:حَنَانًا}} ({{tr:ḥanānan}}) and mediated by {{ar:زَكَاةً}} ({{tr:zakātan}}): tenderness, clean flourishing, and protective character.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated accusatives حَنَانًا and زَكَوٰةً, sourced by مِن لَّدُنَّا, precede the realized state كَانَ تَقِيًّا.
baseline_models.mechanism: Tender mercy and purifying growth are sourced endowments whose cultivation issues in a settled disposition of self-protection.

activation_trace.role: Tender mercy supplies the affective material of the bestowed formation.
Growth makes the gift developmental rather than a static quality.
Purification gives that development an ethical direction.
Realized presence in time turns the preceding gifts into an actual mode of being.
Putting oneself within protection names the disposition produced by the gifts.

changed_reading.before: The ayah lists mercy, purity, and piety as adjacent virtues.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages a sourced formation: tender mercy grows and purifies until it becomes a lived protective disposition.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: حَنَانًا and تَقِيًّا hold زَكَوٰةً between tenderness and guardedness.
baseline_models.mechanism: Tenderness supplies openness to another, protection supplies a boundary against harm, and growth makes those apparently opposed capacities mutually sustaining.

activation_trace.role: Tender mercy supplies responsive openness.
Growth joins openness and restraint into one developing character.
A barrier against injury supplies disciplined restraint.

changed_reading.before: Tenderness is soft, while piety is a separate defensive virtue.
changed_reading.after: Tenderness and protection form one ecology: care needs a boundary, and the boundary exists to preserve care.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: حَنَانًا is immediately sourced مِن لَّدُنَّا and coordinated with growth and guarding.
baseline_models.mechanism: The yearning branch makes the gift centripetal: attraction toward a familiar source directs growth and selective self-protection.

activation_trace.role: Yearning toward what is familiar supplies a homeward pull.
Growth turns that pull into an ongoing trajectory.
Self-placement within protection keeps the trajectory oriented.

changed_reading.before: حَنَانًا denotes only benevolent feeling bestowed from above.
changed_reading.after: It may also name a bestowed longing for the source, a pull that organizes growth and guarded conduct.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening mercy is specified by images of upbringing, completion, feeding, and emergence, so the focus tenderness works as a nurturing process that brings growth to maturity.

activation_trace.role: Tender mercy anchors the changed reading in the focus ayah.
Growth is the focus outcome that nurture develops.
Mercy and softness identify the episode's governing affect.
Upbringing, repair, and completion give mercy a formative function.
The secondary feeding-and-emergence image links nurture directly to growth.

structural_cues: 19:2 frames the entire sequence as a remembered mercy before 19:13 names its formed result.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mercy, nurture, feeding, and focus growth; I infer a process from nurturing cause to formed character. They could instead be parallel descriptions of one gift.

changed_reading.before: The focus tenderness is one isolated favor among several.
changed_reading.after: The tenderness is the nurturing medium through which the episode's initial mercy feeds, repairs, and completes a growing character.

context_deltas.mechanism: A freely given successor crosses an explicitly cut-off line of generation; the repeated near-source construction makes the focus tenderness and growth the qualitative substance of that answered gift.

activation_trace.role: Tender mercy specifies what the near-source gift carries.
Growth supplies the reversal of interrupted generation.
Succession of one thing after another makes continuity the requested function.
The interruption of childbearing supplies the blocked condition that growth reverses.
A gift without exchange marks the successor and his qualities as bestowed rather than produced.

structural_cues: The branchless مِن لَّدُنكَ at 19:5 word 12 recurs as مِن لَّدُنَّا at 19:13 word 3.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cut-off generation, a requested gift, succession, and the repeated near-source phrase; I infer that 19:13 discloses how the answer repairs discontinuity. The recurrence could alternatively mark provenance without causal force.

changed_reading.before: Mercy and growth are generic traits of the child.
changed_reading.after: They are the form taken by an answered gift that converts generational stoppage into tender, guarded continuity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier movement from not being a thing to created existence makes كَانَ in the focus more than a pale copula: it marks piety as a brought-into-presence, stabilized form.

activation_trace.role: Growth anchors the focus state as something brought to development.
Occurrence and presence in time give كَانَ ontic weight in the focus.
Creative bringing-into-existence supplies the transition into formed being.
The negated occurrence of being creates the local contrast for the focus's affirmative state.
A knowable thing supplies the endpoint explicitly denied before creation.

structural_cues: The negated تَكُ شَيْئًا closing 19:9 contrasts with the affirmative كَانَ تَقِيًّا closing 19:13.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies creation, negated being, and an affirmative focus state; I infer a deliberate existence-to-character arc. كَانَ may alternatively remain ordinary predication with only rhetorical, not lexical, added force.

changed_reading.before: كَانَ merely reports that he happened to be pious.
changed_reading.after: His piety appears as a realized mode of being, formed by the same giving power that brings a thing into existence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Concentrated strength and judgment are given in childhood, then immediately bounded by tenderness, purification, and self-protection; the focus qualities govern power rather than compete with it.

activation_trace.role: Cord-like concentrated strength supplies the power that requires governance.
Giving aligns judgment with the bestowed qualities of the focus.
Restraint for the sake of repair makes judgment a checked use of force.
Childhood intensifies the need for an internally governed strength.
Tender mercy directs strength toward responsive care.
Purity keeps the exercise of judgment ethically clean.
Self-placement within protection supplies power's internal limit.

structural_cues: 19:13 directly follows the command to take the book with force and the gift of judgment in childhood.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent force, gifted judgment, childhood, tenderness, purity, and guarding; I infer that the latter regulate the former. They could instead be independent qualifications with no directional hierarchy.

changed_reading.before: Tenderness softens an otherwise forceful commission.
changed_reading.after: Tenderness, purity, and guarding constitute the operating discipline of strength and judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah converts the inward tender guard into social conduct: active filial connection occupies the middle between coercive domination and rebellious rupture.

activation_trace.role: Tender mercy supplies the positive relational impulse.
Protection supplies the restraint that keeps relation from becoming harm.
Connection and beneficence make the focus tenderness behaviorally concrete.
Coercive compulsion names the domination excluded by the tender guard.
Departure from obedience names the opposite rupture also excluded.

structural_cues: The positive بَرًّا is balanced by two negated predicates, جَبَّارًا and عَصِيًّا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies filial beneficence between negated coercion and disobedience; I infer that 19:14 operationalizes 19:13's tenderness and guarding. It could instead append three separate traits.

changed_reading.before: Taqwa is primarily an inward defensive posture.
changed_reading.after: Taqwa is a relational discipline that protects connection by refusing both domination and rupture.

context_deltas.mechanism: Safety is distributed across the three thresholds of birth, death, and reawakening, expanding focus growth and guarding from a momentary virtue into a life-spanning continuity.

activation_trace.role: Growth anchors the focus character in a continuing life process.
Protection anchors the focus character in preservation from harm.
Safety from affliction extends the focus protection across vulnerable transitions.
Repeated durations distribute preservation through distinct temporal phases.
The event of birth supplies the first threshold of the life process.
Loss of force and life supplies the interruption through which continuity must pass.
Rousing the still from rest supplies the reversal of death's interruption.
Preservation of life makes living again the endpoint of guarded continuity.

structural_cues: The threefold يَوْمَ aligns birth, death, and being raised as a single ordered series.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies safety plus three temporal thresholds; I infer that the focus qualities configure a continuity carried through them. The safety may alternatively be an external benediction rather than an unpacking of inner character.

changed_reading.before: Growth and protection describe conduct during ordinary life.
changed_reading.after: They participate in a continuity of guarded life that begins at birth, survives death's interruption, and opens again in reawakening.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the sound branch of ح ن ن rather than its usual affective branch. It remains anchored in حَنَانًا and in the packet's sequence of hidden call, suspended speech, and gesture; downstream prose should present it as an acoustic-gestural overlay, not as a replacement lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: حَنَانًا carries a branch image of a tender resonant sound.

activation_trace.role: The resonant-sound image makes tenderness potentially audible or vibratory.
Raised call supplies the initiating vocal impulse.
The secondary swaying-motion mapping lets the call continue as embodied movement.
Hiddenness keeps the initiating voice below public speech.
Intelligible speech is the vocal connection that the surface construction suspends.
Gesture carries the communicative impulse after ordinary speech is blocked.

changed_reading.before: حَنَانًا is only an inward feeling of mercy.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is also the answer's resonance: a tender impulse carried from hidden voice into silent embodied communication.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because the pair-or-even image of ز ك و comes from a marginal lexical field. It remains visibly anchored by زَكَوٰةً and by the immediately following dual parents plus filial connection; downstream prose should qualify it as a structural echo of relational fit, not a primary sense of zakat.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: زَكَوٰةً has a branch image of pairing or making even.

activation_trace.role: Pairing shifts purity from isolated excellence toward relational complementarity.
Connection and beneficence provide the relation in which complementarity acts.
The parent pair supplies an explicit dual structure immediately after the focus.

changed_reading.before: زَكَوٰةً describes an individual's purity or increase.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it also suggests fitness through relation: growth becomes complete as the child takes a beneficent place within the parent-child bond.

strongest_changes: The repeated near-source construction recasts the focus qualities as the answered gift that crosses interrupted generation.
The adjacency of force and judgment to tenderness, purity, and guarding recasts piety as governed strength.
The following filial and threshold sequence extends inward formation into noncoercive relation and life-spanning preservation.
summary.what_was_special: The focus supports several unmerged mechanisms at once: nurturing formation, a tender protective ecology, homeward longing, and an exploratory resonance that moves from hidden voice into gesture.
remaining_uncertainties: The context-to-focus arrows are abductive; several adjacent descriptions may be parallel rather than causally ordered.
The acoustic ح ن ن and paired ز ك و activations are deliberately branch-distant and should remain qualified.
ل د ن has no branch inventory in the packet, so its repeated near-source construction can support structure but not a fabricated branch citation.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalnızca toynak ağrısından kaçınmayı değil, hafif topallamayı, topallayan atın davranışını, hayvanda yara açmayan eyeri ve aksayışa göre davranma sözünü birlikte verir. Bu nedenle dal korunabilir, fakat geçici hayvanın kendini koruması çerçevesi bütün malzemeyi taşıyacak biçimde aksama ve ona bağlı kullanımlar olarak yeniden kurulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek hafif topallama ve ağrılı ya da hassas toynak yüzünden sakınarak yürümedir; eyer, emir ve sert zemin kullanımları bağımlı yan kullanımlardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tek sözcüklü hafif topallama anlamı, atın yürüyüşü ile eyer ve emir kalıplarına bağlı anlamlardan açıkça ayrılır.

concept_map.definition: Hafif topallama ile, özellikle toynak ağrısı veya hassasiyeti yüzünden yürümekten çekinen ya da sert zeminde ayağını sakınan atın durumu. Aynı kullanım kümesi, hayvanın aksamasına göre davranmayı, sert zeminden yakınmamayı ve hayvanda yara açmayan eyeri de anlatır.

facets.statement: Tek sözcüklü temel anlam, hayvanın yürüyüşündeki hafif topallamadır.
At, topalladığı veya toynağındaki ağrı yüzünden yürümekten çekindiği ve sert zeminde ayağını sakındığı için bu nitelemeyi alır.
Hayvana yönelik emir kalıbı, onun aksayışını gözeterek yürümeyi sürdürme ve kendini zorlamama anlamı taşır.
Eyer için kullanıldığında hayvanın sırtını yaralamayan veya berelenmesine yol açmayan eyer anlatılır.
Sert ve engebeli zeminle kurulan olumsuz emir, arazinin güçlüğünden yakınmama anlamına gelir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak ifadesi hafif topallamayı çekirdek yapar ve bunu topallayan, toynak ağrısı yüzünden yürümekten çekinen ya da sert zeminde ayağını sakınan atla açımlar. Aksamaya göre davranma, sert zeminden yakınmama ve yara açmayan eyer kullanımları aynı kümede yer alan fakat çekirdeğe bağımlı yan kullanımlardır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalı bilinen bir ağırlık ölçüsü olarak doğrular, ancak tek ve değişmez bir nicelik vermez. Bir kullanım kırk gümüş para ağırlığını, başındaki ses düşmüş başka bir biçim ise yağ için yedi temel ağırlık birimini gösterir; tanım bu bağlam farkını açıkça korumalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca bu adlandırılmış ağırlık ölçüsü ve onun biçimleriyle sınırlıdır; genel tartma eylemine, her türlü miktara veya modern bir ölçü adına genişletilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, iki sözcük biçimine bağlı farklı ölçü değerlerini ve çoğul biçimleri ayırır; bunlardan genel bir kök anlamı çıkarmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir kullanımda kırk gümüş paranın ağırlığına, başındaki ses düşmüş başka bir biçim ve kullanımda ise yağ için yedi temel ağırlık birimine eşit kabul edilen ölçü. İlk biçim daha düzgün sayılır ve birden çok çoğul biçimi vardır.

facets.statement: Temel biçim, belirli bir ağırlık ölçüsüdür ve para hesabında kırk gümüş paranın ağırlığına eşitlenir.
Başındaki ses düşmüş biçim, yağ ölçümünde kullanılan ve yedi temel ağırlık birimine eşit sayılan ayrı bir değeri bildirir.
Başlangıç sesini koruyan biçim daha düzgün kabul edilir ve ölçü adının iki çoğul söylenişi kaydedilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak anlatımı, aynı ölçü ailesinde bağlama ve sözcük biçimine göre iki değer aktarır: para hesabında kırk gümüş para ağırlığı ve yağ hesabında yedi temel ağırlık birimi. Başlangıç sesini taşıyan biçim daha düzgün kabul edilir; ölçü adının iki çoğul biçimi de verilir.
